description_en: Binds a custom domain name to a private gateway
description_zh: 私有网关绑定自定义域名
kebab_example: aliyun eas attach-gateway-domain --cluster-id cn-shanghai --gateway-id gw-1uhcqmsc7x22000000 --custom-domain Type=intranet CertificateId=14730025 Domain=test.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachGatewayDomain

parameters.help_en: The region where the private gateway resides
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the private gateway. To obtain the private gateway ID, see the GatewayId parameter in the response parameters of the ListGateway (https://apiworkbench.aliyun-inc.com/document/eas/2021-07-01/ListGateway?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.765e281fL2IcjJ\&ampEnv=online) operation
parameters.help_zh: 私有网关ID。如何获取私有网关ID，请参见接口ListGateway (https://apiworkbench.aliyun-inc.com/document/eas/2021-07-01/ListGateway?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.765e281fL2IcjJ&ampEnv=online)返回结果中的GatewayId字段
parameters.name: gateway_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the SSL certificate bound to the domain name. Obtain the certificate ID after you upload or purchase a certificate in the Certificate Management Service (https://yundunnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.2020520163.console-base_help.2.4b3baJixaJixOc\&p=cas) console
fields.help_zh: 域名绑定的SSL证书ID。请在数字证书管理服务 (https://yundunnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.2020520163.console-base_help.2.4b3baJixaJixOc&p=cas)完成上传或购买证书后获取证书ID
fields.name: certificate_id

fields.help_en:
The domain name type.

Valid value:

intranet: internal network.
internet: public network
fields.name: type

GatewayId.description_en: The ID of the private gateway. To obtain the private gateway ID, see the GatewayId parameter in the response parameters of the ListGateway (https://apiworkbench.aliyun-inc.com/document/eas/2021-07-01/ListGateway?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.765e281fL2IcjJ\&ampEnv=online) operation
GatewayId.description_zh: 私有网关ID。如何获取私有网关ID，请参见接口ListGateway (https://apiworkbench.aliyun-inc.com/document/eas/2021-07-01/ListGateway?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.765e281fL2IcjJ&ampEnv=online)返回结果中的GatewayId字段

Message.example: Successfully update custom endpoint for gateway gw-1uhcqmsc7x22******
